name: Dolphin

launch.notes: ES-DE command: %EMULATOR_DOLPHIN% %ACTION%=android.intent.action.MAIN %CATEGORY%=android.intent.category.LEANBACK_LAUNCHER %EXTRA_AutoStartFile%=%ROMSAF%. Dolphin's StartupHandler.kt reads intent.clipData, then intent.data (content URI, preferred), then extras AutoStartFiles / AutoStartFile (see https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/master/Source/Android/app/src/main/java/org/dolphinemu/dolphinemu/utils/StartupHandler.kt). Setting both data and AutoStartFile is safe.

configTarget.folderToGrant: Dolphin user folder. In the system folder picker open the side menu and choose the 'Dolphin' entry (Dolphin's own DocumentsProvider, authority org.dolphinemu.dolphinemu.user). Legacy installs may instead use /storage/emulated/0/dolphin-emu.
configTarget.notes: User game INIs are loaded from File::GetUserPath(D_GAMESETTINGS_IDX) = <user>/GameSettings (GAMESETTINGS_DIR in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/master/Source/Core/Common/CommonPaths.h). Filenames tried: <first char>.ini, <first 3 chars>.ini, <6-char ID>.ini, <ID>r<revision>.ini; the app writes <6-char ID>.ini. Legacy section names map: Core->Main.Core, Video_Settings->GFX.Settings, Video_Enhancements->GFX.Enhancements, Video_Hacks->GFX.Hacks, Video_Hardware->GFX.Hardware. The user dir is getExternalFilesDir(null) (Android/data, not SAF-pickable) but is exposed by DocumentProvider.kt with FLAG_SUPPORTS_IS_CHILD, so it is pickable via ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/master/Source/Android/app/src/main/java/org/dolphinemu/dolphinemu/features/DocumentProvider.kt, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/master/Source/Android/app/src/main/java/org/dolphinemu/dolphinemu/utils/DirectoryInitialization.kt). MERGE into an existing file; never delete keys the app does not manage. Dolphin also ships read-only Sys/GameSettings with REQUIRED per-game hacks (e.g. GMS.ini sets EFBToTextureEnable = False); user INI values override them, so the app must not write Video_Hacks keys from generic presets.

settings.label: Graphics backend
settings.description: Which GPU API Dolphin renders with. Vulkan is usually faster on Adreno; OpenGL is a fallback when a game shows glitches.

settings.label: CPU emulation engine
settings.description: How the GameCube/Wii CPU is emulated. Leave on JIT ARM64 unless debugging.

settings.label: Dual core (CPU thread)
settings.description: Runs the emulated CPU and GPU on separate host threads. Big speed-up; a few games are unstable with it.

settings.label: Enable CPU clock override
settings.description: Enables the emulated CPU clock override below. Can smooth games with internal slowdown; costs host CPU time.

settings.label: CPU clock multiplier
settings.description: Emulated CPU clock multiplier (1.0 = console speed). Below 1.0 can help weak devices but may break games. Range not verified from source: the UI must only accept values > 0 and warn outside 0.5-2.0.

settings.label: Synchronize GPU thread on idle skip
settings.description: Keeps CPU and GPU threads in step when the game idles. Disabling can be faster but less stable.

settings.label: Internal resolution
settings.description: Rendering scale (EFB scale). Biggest single quality/performance knob. The Thor top screen is 1920x1080, so 3x is the natural target.

settings.label: Shader compilation

options.label: Asynchronous skip drawing (fastest, objects may pop in)

settings.description: How new shaders are compiled. Ubershader modes avoid the classic first-time stutter at a GPU cost.

settings.label: Compile shaders before starting
settings.description: Precompiles the shader cache before the game boots: longer start, fewer hitches.

settings.label: Show FPS overlay
settings.description: Shows Dolphin's FPS counter so you can read the average FPS during a test session.

settings.label: Custom GPU driver file
settings.description: File name of a custom Vulkan driver (e.g. a Turnip build) installed through Dolphin's GPU driver manager. Empty = system driver.

settings.label: Anisotropic filtering
settings.description: Sharper textures at oblique angles. Cheap on Adreno 740.

settings.label: VSync
settings.description: Synchronises presentation with the display refresh. Can reduce tearing, adds latency.

settings.label: Store EFB copies to texture only
settings.description: Faster, but some games REQUIRE this off (Dolphin's own game INIs set it). Only change per game with a reason.

settings.label: Allow CPU access to EFB
settings.description: Some games need CPU reads of the framebuffer (e.g. for lens flares or cursors). Costs performance.

settings.label: VBI skip
settings.description: Skips vertical blank interrupts when behind; smoother on slow devices, can cause issues in some games.

presets.name: Thor Balanced
presets.description: Vulkan, 3x internal resolution (matches the 1080p top screen), asynchronous ubershaders. Starting point for most GC/Wii games on Snapdragon 8 Gen 2.

values.reason: Community Odin 2 (same SoC) guides report switching from OpenGL to Vulkan improves performance in some games (retrogamecorps.com Odin 2 starter guide, seen only as a search-result snippet; site blocked from the research sandbox).

Community Odin 2 guidance says the vast majority of GC/Wii games play at 3x on Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 (search-result snippet of the retrogamecorps.com Odin 2 guide; not fetchable). 3x also matches the Thor's 1080p top panel.
Value semantics from VideoConfig.h (2 = AsynchronousUberShaders). Chosen as the stutter/performance middle ground; no Thor-specific source reachable.
Low-cost enhancement on a flagship GPU; no device-specific source reachable.

values.description: FPS overlay on, so test sessions can record FPS.
values.reason: Required by this app's test procedure (user reads FPS from the emulator overlay).

presets.name: Thor Performance
presets.description: For demanding Wii titles or to save battery: 2x resolution and skip-drawing async shaders.

values.description: 2x native (720p class): roughly half the pixel work of 3x.
values.reason: One step below the 3x community baseline to trade sharpness for headroom.

values.description: Asynchronous, skip drawing: fastest; objects can briefly pop in.
values.reason: Value semantics from VideoConfig.h (3 = AsynchronousSkipRendering); lowest GPU cost option.
Required by this app's test procedure.

presets.name: Thor Quality
presets.description: For light GameCube titles: 4x resolution (supersampled onto the 1080p screen), synchronous ubershaders, 16x AF.

values.description: 4x native (1440p class), downsampled to the 1080p panel.
values.reason: One step above the 3x community baseline; for games with headroom. Verify with a test session.

values.description: Synchronous ubershaders: no pop-in, no compile stutter, highest GPU cost.

values.reason: Quality preset; low cost on Adreno 740.
Required by this app's test procedure.

presets.name: Thor Compatibility (OpenGL)
presets.description: Fallback when a game glitches or crashes on Vulkan: OpenGL ES at 3x with synchronous ubershaders.

values.reason: Standard troubleshooting step: switch backend when one misbehaves. Config name 'OGL' from the OGL backend header.
Avoids async paths while isolating a backend problem.
Required by this app's test procedure.
